order_is_locatable.name: order_is_locatable
order_is_locatable.value: ("order"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "order"."lng" IS NOT NULL) OR "order"."postal_code" IS NOT NULL

order_money_non_negative.name: order_money_non_negative
order_money_non_negative.value:
"order"."est_line_total_cents" >= 0 AND "order"."delivery_fee_cents" >= 0
          AND "order"."est_total_cents" >= 0
          AND ("order"."final_total_cents" IS NULL OR "order"."final_total_cents" >= 0)

order_line_pack_never_repriced.name: order_line_pack_never_repriced
order_line_pack_never_repriced.value:
"order_line"."pricing_mode" <> 'pack'
          OR ("order_line"."act_weight_g" IS NULL
              AND ("order_line"."act_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "order_line"."act_amount_cents" = "order_line"."est_amount_cents"))

order_line_snapshot_matches_mode.name: order_line_snapshot_matches_mode
order_line_snapshot_matches_mode.value:
("order_line"."pricing_mode" = 'pack' AND "order_line"."pack_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "order_line"."rate_per_kg_cents" IS NULL)
          OR ("order_line"."pricing_mode" = 'perKg' AND "order_line"."rate_per_kg_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "order_line"."pack_price_cents" IS NULL)

order_line_money_non_negative.name: order_line_money_non_negative
order_line_money_non_negative.value:
"order_line"."requested_g" >= 0 AND "order_line"."est_amount_cents" >= 0
          AND ("order_line"."act_weight_g" IS NULL OR "order_line"."act_weight_g" >= 0)
          AND ("order_line"."act_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "order_line"."act_amount_cents" >= 0)

product_pricing_mode_xor.name: product_pricing_mode_xor
product_pricing_mode_xor.value:
(
        "product"."pricing_mode" = 'pack'
        AND "product"."pack_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "product"."w_min_g" IS NOT NULL AND "product"."w_max_g" IS NOT NULL
        AND "product"."rate_per_kg_cents" IS NULL AND "product"."min_order_g" IS NULL AND "product"."step_g" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "product"."pricing_mode" = 'perKg'
        AND "product"."rate_per_kg_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "product"."min_order_g" IS NOT NULL AND "product"."step_g" IS NOT NULL
        AND "product"."pack_price_cents" IS NULL AND "product"."w_min_g" IS NULL AND "product"."w_max_g" IS NULL
      )

zone_circle_whole.name: zone_circle_whole
zone_circle_whole.value:
("zone"."centre_lat" IS NULL AND "zone"."centre_lng" IS NULL AND "zone"."radius_m" IS NULL)
          OR ("zone"."centre_lat" IS NOT NULL AND "zone"."centre_lng" IS NOT NULL AND "zone"."radius_m" IS NOT NULL)

zone_circle_on_earth.name: zone_circle_on_earth
zone_circle_on_earth.value:
("zone"."centre_lat" IS NULL
           OR ("zone"."centre_lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "zone"."centre_lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))
          AND ("zone"."radius_m" IS NULL OR "zone"."radius_m" > 0)
